incidente.resumo: An internal configuration-generating system hit a software bug and generated an incorrect configuration that was sent to live services, causing users' requests for their data to be ignored; most users of logged-in services such as Gmail, Google+, Calendar and Documents could not access them for about 25 minutes. The same system, having automatically cleared the error, generated a correct configuration and began sending it at 11:14 a.m.; by 11:30 a.m. it was live everywhere and almost all users' service was restored.

descricao.texto: Users began seeing errors on affected services at 11:02 a.m., and at that time internal monitoring alerted the Site Reliability Team.
trechos: Users began seeing these errors on affected services at 11:02 a.m., and at that time our internal monitoring alerted Google’s Site Reliability Team.

descricao.texto: At 10:55 a.m. PST an internal system that generates configurations encountered a software bug and generated an incorrect configuration; it was sent to live services over the next 15 minutes and caused users' requests for their data to be ignored, so those services generated errors.
trechos: At 10:55 a.m. PST this morning, an internal system that generates configurations—essentially, information that tells other systems how to behave—encountered a software bug and generated an incorrect configuration.
The incorrect configuration was sent to live services over the next 15 minutes, caused users’ requests for their data to be ignored, and those services, in turn, generated errors.

descricao.texto: An incorrect configuration, generated by an internal configuration-generating system because of a software bug, was sent to live services.
trechos: At 10:55 a.m. PST this morning, an internal system that generates configurations—essentially, information that tells other systems how to behave—encountered a software bug and generated an incorrect configuration.
The incorrect configuration was sent to live services over the next 15 minutes, caused users’ requests for their data to be ignored, and those services, in turn, generated errors.

passos.texto: While engineers were still debugging, the same configuration system, having automatically cleared the original error, generated a new correct configuration at 11:14 a.m. and began sending it; errors subsided rapidly, and by 11:30 a.m. the correct configuration was live everywhere and almost all users' service was restored.
trechos: Engineers were still debugging 12 minutes later when the same system, having automatically cleared the original error, generated a new correct configuration at 11:14 a.m. and began sending it; errors subsided rapidly starting at this time.
By 11:30 a.m. the correct configuration was live everywhere and almost all users’ service was restored.

acoes.texto: Correct the bug in the configuration generator, and audit all other critical configuration generation systems for a similar bug.
trechos: Correcting the bug in the configuration generator to prevent recurrence, and auditing all other critical configuration generation systems to ensure they do not contain a similar bug.

acoes.texto: Add input validation checks for configurations so that a bad generated configuration does not result in service disruption.
trechos: Adding additional input validation checks for configurations, so that a bad configuration generated in the future will not result in service disruption.

acoes.texto: Add targeted monitoring to detect and diagnose the cause of service failure more quickly.
trechos: Adding additional targeted monitoring to more quickly detect and diagnose the cause of service failure.
Earlier today, most Google users who use logged-in services like Gmail, Google+, Calendar and Documents found they were unable to access those services for approximately 25 minutes.
